risks: Very large file (~10092 asm lines, ~100 functions). Only 10 true exports are in .public: 0223DD60, 0223DE60, 0223DFBC, 0224140C, 02241474, 022414DC, 02241510, 02242AB4, 02242AC0, 02242AE0. All other ov83_ func_starts are static/local. The ov83_02246E08..ov83_02247CF0 and ov83_022477xx symbols in .public are IMPORTS from a sibling overlay_83 file, NOT defined here.
Many Thumb switch jump tables (_0223DEFE, _0223E020, _0223E168 with 23 cases, _0223E200, _0223E30A, _0223E838, _0223E924, _0223EEB6). MWCC switch lowering (add pc,rN; .short offset table) is fragile.
The 23-case ov83_0223E14C uses `bl _0223EE86` as a long-branch to a shared epilogue (out-of-range b). Matching control flow likely needs goto structure.
Rodata ordering load-bearing: many small u16/BgTemplate/GX-config tables must emit in declaration order.
BgTemplate/WindowTemplate/GXBankConfig structs copied via ldmia/stmia - likely static const globals; cross-ref include/bg_window.h.
0x86C work struct with sub-structs at 0x50 (windows), 0x84c (YesNoPrompt), 0x868 (subsystem) - sub-struct boundaries matter.

IPA: exports 0223DD60/DE60/DFBC are OverlayManager callbacks referenced from an overlay table elsewhere; signatures must be the standard BOOL(OverlayManager*, int*). Do not alter shared overlay_manager.h.
notes: Battle Frontier (Factory-style) opponent/rental/swap UI overlay. Standard OverlayManager Init/Main/Exit triad (0223DD60/DE60/DFBC) driving nested state machines; loads OVY_80 helper overlay (ov80_* imports), heap id 0x6b, NARC 0xb7. Depends heavily on sibling file overlay_83_02246E08 (all imported ov83_0224xxxx UI/sprite helpers) and ov80_*. Recommend decompiling after those siblings, or use local forward decls matched to their state.
